title: Coder 2.32.0 before 2.34.17, 2.35.0 before 2.36.12, 2.37.0 before 2.37.9, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.5 contain a…
description: Coder versions 2.32.0 before 2.34.17, 2.35.0 before 2.36.12, 2.37.0 before 2.37.9, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.5 contain a symlink-following vulnerability in the Coder Agents read_skill_file tool. This flaw allows attackers who place a malicious skill with a symlinked supporting file in a victim's workspace to leak files outside the intended skill directory into the model context and chat history. The vulnerability arises because the tool validates skill file paths lexically but follows symlinks outside the skill directory. The CVSS score is 3.1, indicating low severity. No known exploits in the wild have been reported, and no patch links are provided in the data.
